title: Atomic Habits Lesson Ten
aria: Animated summary of the tenth lesson of Atomic Habits: how to find and fix the causes of your bad habits. Ten scenes.
scenes:
<!-- 1 Title -->
      <g id="s0">
        <text class="m" x="120" y="150" font-size="28">ATOMIC HABITS · CHAPTER 10</text>
        <text class="d" x="116" y="400" font-size="84" letter-spacing="-2">Find and fix the causes</text>
        <text class="d" x="116" y="496" font-size="84" letter-spacing="-2">of your bad habits.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="600" font-size="32">Lesson ten: every craving hides a deeper motive. Press Play for sound.</text>
        <path class="s-line" d="M1180 640h300" stroke-width="5"/>
        <path class="s-gain" d="M1330 640v80M1330 680l-50 50M1330 690l60 40M1290 720l-30 40" fill="none" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g id="lens"><circle class="s-ink" cx="1330" cy="430" r="96" fill="var(--stage)" fill-opacity=".6" stroke-width="16"/><path class="s-ink" d="M1398 498l70 70" stroke-width="26" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 2 Allen Carr -->
      <g id="s1" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">Allen Carr changed the story.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">A former heavy smoker’s book on quitting, the 1980s.</text>
        <g transform="translate(140 340)">
          <path d="M520 0c-22-32 22-48 2-82s20-40 8-62" fill="none" class="s-line" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <rect class="gain" x="0" y="20" width="110" height="56"/>
          <rect class="s-ink" x="110" y="20" width="380" height="56" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="7"/>
          <rect class="s-ink" x="0" y="20" width="490" height="56" fill="none" stroke-width="7"/>
          <rect class="ink" x="490" y="20" width="44" height="56"/>
        </g>
        <g id="o0"><text id="ot0" class="d5" x="120" y="560" font-size="42" fill-opacity=".55">“I’m giving something up.”</text></g>
        <line id="os0" class="s-ink" x1="112" y1="546" x2="112" y2="546" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g id="n0"><text class="d" x="120" y="620" font-size="46">There’s nothing to give up.</text></g>
        <g id="o1"><text id="ot1" class="d5" x="860" y="560" font-size="42" fill-opacity=".55">“It relieves my stress.”</text></g>
        <line id="os1" class="s-ink" x1="852" y1="546" x2="852" y2="546" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g id="n1"><text class="d" x="860" y="620" font-size="46">It creates the stress.</text></g>
        <g id="quit"><text class="d" x="120" y="800" font-size="52">Many readers quit for good.</text><rect class="gain" x="124" y="826" width="120" height="10"/></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 3 Iceberg -->
      <g id="s2" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">Surface craving. Deeper motive.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">You don’t crave the thing. You crave what it gives you.</text>
        <rect class="loss" x="0" y="420" width="1600" height="480" fill-opacity=".1"/>
        <path id="wave" class="s-loss" fill="none" stroke-width="4"/>
        <polygon class="s-ink" points="700,420 760,290 850,270 910,420" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <polygon class="s-ink" points="560,420 1050,420 1130,600 990,800 610,800 470,600" fill="var(--stage)" fill-opacity=".75" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="14 10"/>
        <text class="m" x="120" y="270" font-size="22">WHAT YOU THINK YOU CRAVE</text>
        <g id="u0"><text class="d" x="120" y="330" font-size="48">A cigarette.</text></g>
        <g id="u1"><text class="d" x="120" y="390" font-size="48">Scrolling.</text></g>
        <text class="m" x="1180" y="480" font-size="22">WHAT YOU REALLY CRAVE</text>
        <g id="d0"><text class="d" x="800" y="510" font-size="44" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:var(--gain)">Relief</text></g>
        <g id="d1"><text class="d" x="800" y="580" font-size="44" text-anchor="middle">Connection</text></g>
        <g id="d2"><text class="d" x="800" y="650" font-size="44" text-anchor="middle">Approval</text></g>
        <g id="d3"><text class="d" x="800" y="720" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">Knowing what’s going on</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 4 Ancient motives -->
      <g id="s3" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">Ancient motives, modern solutions.</text>
        <text class="m" x="120" y="226" font-size="22">ANCIENT MOTIVES</text>
        <g id="chips"></g>
        <g id="links"></g>
        <text class="m" x="1480" y="740" font-size="22" text-anchor="end">MODERN SOLUTIONS</text>
        <g id="m0"><rect class="gain" x="120" y="560" width="440" height="120" rx="16"/><text class="d5" x="150" y="636" font-size="40" style="fill:var(--on-gain)">Dating apps</text></g>
        <g id="m1"><rect class="gain" x="580" y="560" width="440" height="120" rx="16"/><text class="d5" x="610" y="636" font-size="40" style="fill:var(--on-gain)">Social media</text></g>
        <g id="m2"><rect class="gain" x="1040" y="560" width="440" height="120" rx="16"/><text class="d5" x="1070" y="636" font-size="40" style="fill:var(--on-gain)">Search engines</text></g>
        <g id="same"><text class="d" x="120" y="800" font-size="48">Our habits are new answers to old desires.</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 5 Prediction -->
      <g id="s4" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">A craving is a prediction.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">Something feels missing, and you predict a habit will fix it.</text>
        <g id="chain"></g>
        <g id="miss"><rect class="s-muted" x="840" y="520" width="280" height="90" rx="12" fill="none" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="10 10"/><text class="m" x="980" y="572" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">SOMETHING FEELS MISSING</text></g>
        <g id="chg"><text class="d" x="120" y="790" font-size="48">Change the prediction, and you change the craving.</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 6 Reframe -->
      <g id="s5" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">Swap one word.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">From “have to” to “get to”.</text>
        <g id="r0o"><text id="rt0" class="d5" x="120" y="330" font-size="52" fill-opacity=".55">I have to go for a run.</text></g>
        <line id="rs0" class="s-ink" x1="112" y1="312" x2="112" y2="312" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g id="r0n"><text class="d" x="120" y="420" font-size="64">I <tspan style="fill:var(--gain)">get to</tspan> build my endurance.</text></g>
        <g id="r1o"><text id="rt1" class="d5" x="120" y="580" font-size="52" fill-opacity=".55">I have to save money.</text></g>
        <line id="rs1" class="s-ink" x1="112" y1="562" x2="112" y2="562" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g id="r1n"><text class="d" x="120" y="670" font-size="64">I <tspan style="fill:var(--gain)">get to</tspan> buy myself freedom.</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 7 Nervous or excited -->
      <g id="s6" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">Nervous before a big presentation?</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">Your heart is racing either way.</text>
        <g id="heart" transform="translate(400 470)"><path id="heartP" d="M0 120C-150 20-160-90-75-110C-35-120-8-92 0-70C8-92 35-120 75-110C160-90 150 20 0 120Z"/></g>
        <polyline id="ecg" class="s-ink" fill="none" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g id="lblN"><text class="d" x="760" y="440" font-size="96" style="fill:var(--loss)">Nervous</text></g>
        <line id="lnS" class="s-ink" x1="752" y1="408" x2="752" y2="408" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g id="lblE"><text class="d" x="760" y="560" font-size="96" style="fill:var(--gain)">Excited</text></g>
        <g id="works"><text class="d" x="120" y="800" font-size="48">Call it excitement, and it starts to work for you.</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 8 Motivation ritual -->
      <g id="s7" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">Build a motivation ritual.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">Pair something you enjoy with the habit, again and again.</text>
        <g id="hp" transform="translate(280 430)">
          <path class="s-ink" d="M-100 40v-30a100 100 0 0 1 200 0v30" fill="none" stroke-width="16"/>
          <rect class="ink" x="-124" y="20" width="56" height="96" rx="20"/><rect class="ink" x="68" y="20" width="56" height="96" rx="20"/>
        </g>
        <text class="d" x="460" y="470" font-size="80" style="fill:var(--muted)">+</text>
        <g transform="translate(620 360)">
          <rect class="s-ink" x="0" y="0" width="150" height="190" rx="10" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="7"/>
          <path class="s-line" d="M28 50h94M28 90h94M28 130h60" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <path class="gain" d="M170 160l70-120 22 12-70 120-30 14z"/>
        </g>
        <path class="s-muted" d="M920 455h90m-24-24 24 24-24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <g id="zone"><rect class="gain" x="1050" y="400" width="400" height="110" rx="55"/><text class="d" x="1250" y="472" font-size="44" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:var(--on-gain)">In the zone</text></g>
        <g id="reps"></g>
        <text class="m" x="120" y="690" font-size="20">EACH TIME YOU PAIR THEM</text>
        <g id="ed"><text class="d5" x="120" y="790" font-size="40">Ed Latimore’s focus jumped just by putting headphones on.</text>
        <text class="m" x="120" y="840" font-size="22" style="fill:var(--gain)">OVER TIME, THE RITUAL BECOMES THE CUE</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 9 Make it unattractive -->
      <g id="s8" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">To break a bad habit, flip it.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">Make it unattractive.</text>
        <path class="s-ink" d="M250 330v130a70 70 0 0 0 140 0V330" fill="none" stroke-width="56"/>
        <rect class="loss" x="222" y="290" width="56" height="50"/><rect class="loss" x="362" y="290" width="56" height="50"/>
        <circle id="pushed" class="loss" cx="320" cy="640" r="24"/>
        <text class="m" x="700" y="320" font-size="22">REMIND YOURSELF WHAT YOU GAIN BY STOPPING</text>
        <g id="g0"><text class="d" x="700" y="410" font-size="56"><tspan style="fill:var(--gain)">+</tspan> More money</text></g>
        <g id="g1"><text class="d" x="700" y="500" font-size="56"><tspan style="fill:var(--gain)">+</tspan> Better sleep</text></g>
        <g id="g2"><text class="d" x="700" y="590" font-size="56"><tspan style="fill:var(--gain)">+</tspan> More time</text></g>
        <g id="g3"><text class="d" x="700" y="680" font-size="56"><tspan style="fill:var(--gain)">+</tspan> More energy</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 10 Close -->
      <g id="s9" opacity="0">
        <g id="qa"><text class="d" x="136" y="340" font-size="88" letter-spacing="-2">What’s one “have to”</text></g>
        <g id="qb"><text class="d" x="136" y="450" font-size="88" letter-spacing="-2">in your life that you could</text></g>
        <g id="qc"><text class="d" x="136" y="560" font-size="88" letter-spacing="-2">turn into a “<tspan style="fill:var(--gain)">get to</tspan>”?</text></g>
        <text class="m" x="143" y="700" font-size="26">REFRAME THE HABIT</text>
      </g>
NAMES: ['Causes','Allen Carr','Surface and motive','Ancient motives','Prediction','Have to, get to','Nervous or excited','Motivation ritual','Make it unattractive','The question']
